name: Hallowed Letter
summary: In Northshire, Marshal McBride gives promising young priests a letter from Priestess Anetta. It calls them to begin formal training in the Holy Light at Northshire Abbey, while trouble still shadows the realm.

sections.title: A Summons to the Cloth
sections.body: After proving themselves against the kobold camps around Northshire, novice priests receive a letter sealed by Priestess Anetta. Marshal McBride delivers it as an invitation to study the Holy Light in the abbey's quiet halls.

sections.title: A World in Need
sections.body: When you bring the letter, Priestess Anetta tells you the realm remains troubled. The Burning Legion's lingering threats still shadow Azeroth, and the continents bear fresh wounds and unrest. To Anetta, becoming a priest means more than study. It is a duty to bring healing and comfort to a suffering world.

faq.answer: It is a sealed letter bearing Priestess Anetta's crest, delivered by Marshal McBride to newly arrived human priests in Northshire Valley. It directs the novice to continue formal training inside Northshire Abbey.
Priestess Anetta, the priest trainer in Northshire Abbey, writes and seals the letter. She asks Marshal McBride to hand it over when the initiate returns from scouting the kobold infestation.

faq.q: Why does Priestess Anetta summon new priests?
faq.answer: Anetta recognizes your calling to the Holy Light and wants to guide your training. With dangers such as the Burning Legion's remnants still in the world, she says disciplined healers and guides are urgently needed.

faq.q: Where can Priestess Anetta be found?
faq.answer: Priestess Anetta lives in the main hall of Northshire Abbey. There, she trains human priests in their first prayers and rituals.

faq.q: What happens after presenting the letter to Priestess Anetta?
faq.answer: After reading the letter and greeting Anetta, she accepts you as her student. She shares basic wisdom and invites you to return for more training as you gain experience.

faq.q: Why is the Burning Legion mentioned in Northshire?
aliases: why does anetta talk about demons
faq.answer: Though the Third War has ended, demonic remnants of the Burning Legion still haunt Azeroth. Anetta mentions this wider threat to show the dangers awaiting anyone who leaves the valley.

angles.text: As a priest, you begin your formal study of the Holy Light under Priestess Anetta. Your magic carries a duty to heal a fractured world.
As a human, you find Northshire Abbey, a sanctuary of faith and recovery for the Kingdom of Stormwind. It keeps its traditions amid the troubles around Elwynn.
